basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old IT technician based out of Cardiff, Wales. I enjoy exploring the world of web scraping and have a keen interest in data analysis. Outside of work, I love spending time with my partner and our two cats. On weekends, you can find me trying out new recipes or playing around with gacha mobile games. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and sometimes during lunch breaks. I'm married and enjoy discussing relationship dynamics and sharing experiences on subreddits like MarriedSex.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science and have been working in IT for the past five years. Much of my web scraping knowledge is self-taught through online courses and community forums. I stay up-to-date with the latest technology trends by reading tech blogs and participating in relevant subreddit discussions.
